(let [cols ["ip_country" "eur_amount" "has_fraudulent_dispute"]]
  (loop [p (dabstep.payments/read-page nil cols) agg {}]
    (let [rows (get p "rows")
          a (reduce (fn [m row]
              (let [c (nth row 0) x (nth row 1) f (nth row 2)]
                (if (and c x)
                  (let [v (get m c [0.0 0.0])]
                    (assoc m c [(+ (nth v 0) (if f x 0.0)) (+ (nth v 1) x)]))
                  m)))
            agg rows)
          next (get p "next_cursor")]
      (if next
        (recur (dabstep.payments/read-page next cols) a)
        (return {:countries (vec (map (fn [[c v]] {:ip_country c :fraudulent_volume (nth v 0) :total_volume (nth v 1)}) a))}))))))

(let [definition (dabstep.payments/fraud-definition) cols ["ip_country" "eur_amount" "has_fraudulent_dispute"] first (dabstep.payments/read-page nil cols)] (println definition) (loop [rows (get first "rows") cursor (get first "next_cursor") calls (get first "read_calls")] (if cursor (let [p (dabstep.payments/read-page cursor cols)] (recur (into rows (get p "rows")) (get p "next_cursor") (+ calls (get p "read_calls")))) (let [agg (reduce (fn [m row] (let [c (nth row 0) a (nth row 1) f (nth row 2)] (if (and c a) (let [old (get m c {:fraudulent_volume 0.0 :total_volume 0.0})] (assoc m c {:fraudulent_volume (+ (get old :fraudulent_volume) (if f a 0.0)) :total_volume (+ (get old :total_volume) a)})) m))) {} rows) out (map (fn [[c v]] {:ip_country c :fraudulent_volume (get v :fraudulent_volume) :total_volume (get v :total_volume)}) agg)] (return {:countries (vec out)})))))

(let [cols ["ip_country" "eur_amount" "has_fraudulent_dispute"]
      definition (dabstep.payments/fraud-definition)
      agg (loop [cursor nil acc {}]
            (let [p (dabstep.payments/read-page cursor cols)
                  next (get p "next_cursor")
                  updated (reduce (fn [m row]
                             (let [country (nth row 0)
                                   amount (nth row 1)
                                   fraudulent (nth row 2)]
                               (if (and country amount)
                                 (let [old (get m country [0.0 0.0])]
                                   (assoc m country
                                          [(+ (nth old 0) (if fraudulent amount 0.0))
                                           (+ (nth old 1) amount)]))
                                 m)))
                           acc
                           (get p "rows"))]
              (if next (recur next updated) updated)))]
  (return {"countries" (vec (map (fn [[country volumes]]
                                    {"ip_country" country
                                     "fraudulent_volume" (nth volumes 0)
                                     "total_volume" (nth volumes 1)})
                                  agg))
           "problems" ["The analyzer appears to rank countries by raw fraudulent volume, but the official fraud definition is fraudulent volume divided by total volume; this can produce a wrong top-country conclusion. For these measurements, BE has a slightly higher fraud ratio than NL despite NL having the larger raw fraudulent volume."]}))
